evidence: eval_script.py invocation: python3 eval_script.py; no CLI args.

eval_script.py loads test_prints.json (48 hidden prints = 12 months x 4 CPI/PCE series), invokes /home/workspace/cpi_nowcast_book.py --backtest once against the full 2025 monthly panel (with 2024 lookback for YoY computation), parses nowcast_results.json, per-print recomputes YoY MAE + positioning-book PnL + directional beat rate, calls score.py per lane, aggregates with cross-series stability + Fed-pivot bonus, emits TOTAL_SCORE <N> on stdout.

score.py implements 8 per-lane scoring functions with anchors capped at macroeconomic-frontier values per PKW-FAMILIES section 3 Framework B (headline CPI MAE floor 0.10pp; positioning book PnL Sharpe cap 1.5).
nowcast_results.json is generated by the submitted cpi_nowcast_book.py at judge time, so it is not listed as a required submission file.
true_fed_pivot_events.json is a hidden scoring label file used only for the +10 Fed-pivot bonus lane.
warnings: The expert scorer assumes hidden scoring data files are copied from /home/workspace/scoring/ into /home/workspace/ before invocation.
The scoring directory contains cpi_nowcast_reference.py used ONLY under Oracle placement; the manifest treats /home/workspace/cpi_nowcast_book.py as the worker submission.
Validation failures inside eval_script.py that fail before emitting TOTAL_SCORE will produce parse_failure and zero out per the failure_policy.
